example-production.description: Example target. Copy this file to local/databases.json and replace the placeholders with the project's documented public endpoint. 'withheld' lists whole tables ('*') and columns the role must not read; the tool refuses to run if it can. 'other_databases' lists other databases in the cluster the role may connect to after the owner audited them (stock postgres/template1 hold no data); the tool refuses unlisted ones.
